spirits.line: An ancient gardener spirit who remembers every seed ever planted in the Haven.
spirits.name: The Moss Keeper

spirits.line: A sleepy moth spirit who trades in twilight secrets and naps through noon.
spirits.name: The Dusk Moth

spirits.line: A bright young spark who fell off the constellation map and never climbed back.
spirits.name: The Star Wisp

spirits.line: A gruff thorn spirit with bark worse than his bite and a soft spot for underdogs.
spirits.name: Bramble

spirits.line: A warm ember that has burned low for a hundred years and never quite gone out.
spirits.name: The Ember Wisp

spirits.line: A chorus of night-blooming voices that sings every wish in rounds.
spirits.name: The Nightchoir
The Thorn Warden
spirits.line: A bramble-knight who pricks only those who deserve it.

spirits.name: The Crystal Wisp
spirits.line: A shard of living quartz that hums forgotten lullabies.

spirits.name: The Mooncap Elder
spirits.line: Oldest of the mooncap folk; remembers when the Haven was wild.

spirits.name: The Petal Dancer
spirits.line: She dances only at dusk, and only for blooming gardens.

spirits.name: The Root Guardian
spirits.line: A silent sentinel woven from the Haven's deepest roots.

spirits.name: The Gloom Batling
spirits.line: A shy little bat who collects lost starlight in a thimble.
